description: Two adders in 2HP, each summing four inputs into one output, with an averaging mode and a choice of what to do with negative voltages

params.text: Switches that section between adding its inputs and averaging them; green is averaging

inputs.text: One of the four signals that section adds; unpatched jacks are left out

outputs.text: Carries that section's four inputs added together, or their average when the button is green

notes: the output channel count follows the input with the most channels, and a shorter polyphonic input contributes 0V to the channels it does not have
a monophonic input is added to every channel of a polyphonic one, so mixing a mono signal into a poly one works without a splitter
menu: A-Negative mode, B-Negative mode: Signed (default), Zero, Absolute (input), Absolute (output) — chooses what that section does with negative voltages before or after the sum
Quantize mode — rounds the output to the nearest step of the size chosen, from a twelfth of a volt up to 5V, and is Off unless you set it
Clipping range — clamps every output to the range chosen, -12V to 12V unless you change it, and Off lets the output run to any voltage
Process quality: Audio, High, Balanced, Low, Very low — sets how often the module runs its algorithm, from every cycle down to every 256th; below Balanced a 1ms trigger can be missed
